newsitem.title: USA: SEC action against Ariz Cty sets precedent - Maco.
newsitem.headline: SEC action against Ariz Cty sets precedent - Maco.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission's enforcement action against Maricopa County, Ariz. on Monday is precedent setting, Paul Maco, director of SEC's Office of Municipal Securities said.
Maco, in a telephone interview, said that it is the first by the agency against a general purpose issuer of municipal bonds where the securities were not in default.
"The remedies given us by Congress are, among other things, remedial in nature," Maco said.
"That includes such things as (using a) cease and desist order where disclosure seems to be lacking," Maco added.
Asked what message the SEC is trying to send issuers with today's action, Maco said he could not comment on this specific case.
But in general, he said, when issuers supply financial information to investors in offering documents, those investors must be alerted to material changes in issuer finances.
The SEC has brought only one other case against a general purpose issuer where it charged failure to disclose adequately financial information.
The SEC earlier this year settled securities fraud charges with Orange County, Calif.
